name: Poblano Pepper
siboNotes: Well-tolerated in SIBO diets as poblanos are naturally FODMAP-free and low in fermentable fibers.
preparationTips: Roast over open flame or under broiler until skin is charred, then steam in bag to remove skin easily
Remove seeds and membranes to reduce heat level if sensitive to spice
Can be stuffed, grilled, or added to stews and salsas
Freeze roasted poblanos for up to 6 months for convenient use
nutritionalHighlights: High in vitamin C for immune support
Good source of vitamin A for eye health
Low in calories but high in flavor
